TB-BM-01.statement: When a scan starts with the bank open, the addon shall query each accessible tab in turn and read slots only after that tab's update signal.

TB-BM-02.statement: If a tab is inaccessible or times out, then the addon shall mark it unknown and shall not export it as empty.

TB-BM-03.statement: If bank contents change during a scan, then the addon shall retry the affected tab or mark the scan unstable.

TB-BM-04.statement: If the bank closes during a scan, then the addon shall abort and keep the previous completed snapshot.

TB-BM-05.statement: When an export is requested, the addon shall present the snapshot as selectable parts of at most 1,800 characters each.

TB-BM-06.statement: When all parts arrive, the service shall reassemble in any order, verify the CRC32, validate the schema and show a preview.

TB-BM-07.statement: If a snapshot ID is imported again, then the service shall return the earlier receipt for identical content and reject different content.

TB-BM-08.statement: If a snapshot is older than a tab's baseline, then the service shall keep it as history and leave the baseline unchanged.

TB-BM-09.statement: When a partial snapshot is accepted, the service shall update only observed tabs and retain the others at their previous age.

TB-BM-10.statement: The service shall resolve exports of one physical bank by different uploaders to one source.

TB-BM-11.statement: When a request is assigned, the service shall notify the manager by DM and list it in the website queue.

TB-BM-12.statement: If a manager DM fails, then the service shall keep the assignment, retry within limits and notify the fallback channel.

TB-BM-13.statement: When a delivery is recorded, the service shall reduce the reservation and allocation and create the pending outgoing in one transaction.

TB-BM-14.statement: While a pending outgoing has no later observation covering it, the service shall keep that quantity unavailable.

TB-BM-15.statement: The service shall label a matching quantity change as consistent with reported movement and shall not infer who was fulfilled.

TB-BM-16.statement: If a Discord action carries a stale revision, then the service shall reject it and show current state.

TB-DM-01.statement: The domain and application modules shall import no adapter, framework, SQL client, Discord library or Blizzard global.

TB-DM-02.statement: The addon's domain and serialization modules shall run under standalone Lua with no WoW client.

TB-DM-03.statement: The Lua and TypeScript codebases shall validate against the same checked-in contract fixtures.

TB-DM-04.statement: Where the client lacks guild-bank capability, the addon shall report the source as unsupported and shall not scan.

TB-DM-05.statement: The stack shall start from a clean clone with one compose command.

TB-DM-06.statement: Every mutating use case shall accept an idempotency key and, where an entity exists, its expected revision.

TB-DM-07.statement: The service shall reject imports above 1 MiB decoded, 800 parts or a 30-minute session, and bound depth, integers and indices.

TB-DM-08.statement: The service shall escape imported names and suppress mentions in all bot output.

TB-DM-09.statement: When a snapshot is accepted, the service shall publish one outbox event; website and Discord updates shall retry without re-importing.

TB-DM-10.statement: If a pull request adds a capability with no EARS statement and linked scenario, then CI shall fail.

TB-DM-11.statement: When a release tag is cut, the pipeline shall publish versioned images and the addon archive from that one tag.

TB-GM-01.statement: The service shall show each permitted physical bank as its tabs and slots, in captured slot order.

TB-GM-02.statement: The service shall show observed, pending outgoing, raid held, direct reserved and general available quantities for every item.

TB-GM-03.statement: The service shall show the observation age of every source and the capture-time range of every aggregate.

TB-GM-04.statement: The service shall exclude sources a member may not see from every aggregate shown to that member.

TB-GM-05.statement: When a member submits a request, the service shall reserve the quantity atomically or reject the request.

TB-GM-06.statement: If a request exceeds available stock, then the service shall offer a waitlisted request that holds no reservation.

TB-GM-07.statement: When a member cancels a request, the service shall release only the outstanding quantity and keep recorded deliveries.

TB-GM-08.statement: While a source's latest observation is older than the review threshold, the service shall block new reservations against it.

TB-GM-09.statement: The service shall apply the same use cases and stock to requests from the website and from Discord.

TB-RL-01.statement: The service shall store a raid profile with timezone, recurrence, managers and item templates.

TB-RL-02.statement: When a raid occurrence is created, the service shall give it its own allocations and copy none from earlier occurrences.

TB-RL-03.statement: The service shall count each physical bank once in the holistic view, whatever raid views draw on it.

TB-RL-04.statement: If an allocation would commit more than the eligible projected stock, then the service shall reject it.

TB-RL-05.statement: When a request draws on a raid allocation, the service shall reduce raid availability and leave general availability unchanged.

TB-RL-06.statement: When a raid occurrence expires, the service shall release unused commitments under the configured policy and write an audit event.

TB-RL-07.statement: The service shall report shortfall per target as max(0, target - eligibleAvailable), allocating free stock once across competing targets.

TB-RL-08.statement: Where a raid uses a dedicated physical bank, the service shall show it beside virtual allocations in the raid view.
